message: So there I was, in the middle of a cozy blackout, and my family group chat lit up brighter than my flashlight! Everyone was sharing their makeshift solutions—my sister was using her power bank to charge her phone while my brother was trying to keep his kids entertained with shadow puppets. It was a reminder that even in the dark, we can stay connected and creative. If you find yourself in a power outage, remember to keep those phones charged and find the fun in the unexpected! Anyone else have a favorite blackout story to share?
